items.title_en: Telangana CM Intervenes After Cops Shut Kumari Aunty's Food Stall Citing Traffic Congestion
items.title_zh: 警察以交通拥堵为由关闭库玛丽阿姨的食品摊后，特伦甘纳邦首长介入
items.summary_en: The police cited traffic congestion as the reason for shutting down Kumari Aunty’s food stall and urged her to relocate to ease the traffic situation in the IT sector stretch.
items.summary_zh: 警方以交通拥堵为由关闭了库玛丽阿姨的小吃摊，并敦促她搬迁，以缓解 IT 区的交通状况。
